item: receipt-revision-gate exit-code and code table by execution

exit_paths.condition: at least one receipt refused; verdict line codes=<named>

resolve(lane, --certified) returns None: unresolvable certified revision OR lane that is not a git repo / does not exist; printed as 'GATE: error=unresolvable-certified ... codes=RECEIPT_REV_UNRESOLVABLE'; runs before receipts are parsed

exit_paths.emitted_at: receipt-revision-gate.py:92 (bad ROLE), :183-184 (unknown flag or positional), :187-188 (missing --lane/--certified/--receipt), :358 with no-args; :353 selftest failing (not observed)
exit_paths.condition: usage error via SystemExit(str); no named code

exit_paths.emitted_at: uncaught exception: :173,:175,:177,:179 IndexError (flag with no value); :197 FileNotFoundError or UnicodeDecodeError (--paths file); :106 read_bytes PermissionError (untested)
exit_paths.condition: traceback, no named code, no usage text

argparse_note: the gate parses argv by hand; no argparse exit 2 exists. Exit 2 means only an unresolvable --certified (or lane).

codes.observed: rc 3; directory receipt; empty receipt path ':positive' resolves to '.'
rc 3; case 30 is a 6-hex rev= token that REV_RE (7-40 hex) does not match, detail 'no rev= token'
rc 3; case 07 is one commit named by abbreviated and full sha, refused; control role accepts the same input (extra 41)
line 133: receipt rev, rc 3; line 192: certified rev, rc 2 (the only exit-2 emission)
rc 3 when paths is None (line 145); also when --paths '' (line 196 treats empty string as absent)
rc 3 when paths given and listed bytes differ; also for empty paths file (drift detail '<no --paths given ...>') and for a listed path absent from both revs
rc 3; control naming a side-branch rev

discrepancies.claim: verdict receipt naming another revision on the declared --paths surface -> RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH
discrepancies.observed: with --paths: RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT (rc 3) when bytes drift, PASS when identical; RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH only without --paths
discrepancies.fix: row 53 code cell: RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT with --paths; RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH without --paths

discrepancies.artifact: receipt-revision-gate.py header line 25; registry.json row receipt-revision-gate-selftest scratch_root text

discrepancies.claim: 'Exit 0 iff PASS' with no other exits documented
discrepancies.observed: exit 1 is used for usage errors and uncaught tracebacks (fixtures 22, 24-28, 27, 34, 35, 43). The 0/2/3 map in T57W1ExecStandingRules.md is incomplete.
discrepancies.fix: map must read 0 PASS; 1 usage or uncaught error (no named code); 2 certified/lane unresolvable; 3 refused with named codes

discrepancies.artifact: receipt-revision-gate.py header line 31 (verdict line format) and --json contract
discrepancies.claim: verdict line 'GATE: receipts=N ok=N refused=N codes=... verdict=...'; --json emits schema tameshi-receipt-gate-v1
discrepancies.observed: exit-2 path prints 'GATE: error=unresolvable-certified receipts=N verdict=REFUSED codes=...' and ignores --json (prints text)
discrepancies.fix: document the exit-2 line form; emit JSON or document text-only on that path

discrepancies.claim: accepted content-identical rev != certified: 'the line says so'
discrepancies.observed: GATE OK line prints revs=<other rev> with no marker that rev differs from certified
discrepancies.fix: either print a marker in the OK line or correct the comment

discrepancies.artifact: receipt-revision-gate.py lines 76-77 (drifted_paths empty-list branch) reached via run() line 196-198
discrepancies.claim: branch message '<no --paths given: content identity is not checkable>'
discrepancies.observed: reached when --paths names a file with no path lines; emits RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT rc 3 with a message saying no --paths was given
discrepancies.fix: usage error (exit 1) or could-not-evaluate for an empty paths file; fix the message

discrepancies.observed: --paths '' is silently treated as absent: strict RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH rc 3, no usage error
discrepancies.fix: reject empty --paths as usage (exit 1) or treat by is-not-None

discrepancies.observed: a nonexistent or non-git --lane also yields RECEIPT_REV_UNRESOLVABLE rc 2 (names the revision, not the lane)

discrepancies.claim: usage and refusal codes are named
discrepancies.observed: certified resolution (190-194) precedes receipt parsing (201) and --paths read (197): an unresolvable --certified hides a bad ROLE (rc 2, not 1) and a missing --paths file (rc 2, not traceback). Exit code of a multi-error call depends on check order.
discrepancies.fix: document the check order or validate arguments before resolving

discrepancies.artifact: receipt-revision-gate.py lines 170-185, 197, 106 (uncaught exceptions) and header line 25
discrepancies.claim: every refusal is a named code
discrepancies.observed: flag with no value (IndexError), missing --paths file (FileNotFoundError), unreadable paths file or receipt (PermissionError untested) escape as tracebacks with exit 1 and no named code
discrepancies.fix: catch OSError/IndexError into usage exit 1 with a message

discrepancies.artifact: receipt-revision-gate.py line 140 (len(revs) > 1) vs control role (no ambiguity check); header line 16 'Exactly one distinct rev= token'
discrepancies.claim: positive ambiguity is about 'distinct rev= token'
discrepancies.observed: token strings, not resolved commits: one commit named abbreviated+full is RECEIPT_REV_AMBIGUOUS for positive/verdict (rc 3) but PASS for control (extra 41). resolved{} is computed but not used for ambiguity.
discrepancies.fix: compare resolved commits, or document token-level ambiguity and make control consistent

discrepancies.artifact: receipt-revision-gate.py line 43 (REV_RE 7-40 hex) and SKILL row 56
discrepancies.claim: RECEIPT_REV_ABSENT means 'names no revision at all'
discrepancies.observed: a 6-hex rev= token is invisible to the regex: RECEIPT_REV_ABSENT with detail 'no rev= token' although a too-short revision is named
discrepancies.fix: detail text, or a short-rev code; SKILL row 56 wording

discrepancies.observed: a PATH containing ':' is a usage error exit 1 (role parsed from the path fragment)
discrepancies.fix: document or parse from the right

discrepancies.observed: unfinished self-correction in source: 'a receipt that git knows must be a blob at the certified revision's tree? No:'
